note: The IFC and Arab Monetary Fund's Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015) on the Libyan Credit Information Center: lenders report only on business customers, and it doesn't collect or keep credit information on individuals, so no record of a person's credit is kept; registered as secondary, the Central Bank of Libya's own rules not read.

sources.title: IFC and Arab Monetary Fund, Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015)
sources.said: Lenders only provide data on business customers, so ... the LCIC can only offer its members commercial credit ... information reports. The LCIC does not collect or maintain ... credit information related to individuals.
